Definition: Bel, the Baal of the Babylonians
BiblicalUsage: Bel means "lord." He was a chief Babylonian deity. It turns up in Isaiah 46:1, Jeremiah 50:2 and Jeremiah 51:44.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Bel is in Scripture for a reason, and no name there is an accident.
